eventContent:
Step into the future of healthcare at the Gujarat Medical Expo 2026 – where innovation meets expertise!




🔥 After the Grand Success of the 1st Edition, Now the 2nd Edition is Bigger & Better!

Join us from 25th to 27th September 2026, starting at 10:00 AM, at the prestigious Vigyan Bhawan, Science City, Ahmedabad.




Explore a world of cutting-edge advancements across:

Medical Equipment
Laboratory Technologies
Pharmaceutical Innovations
Clinic & Hospital Solutions
Surgical Instruments




This expo is a must-attend for doctors, hospital owners, medical professionals, distributors, and healthcare entrepreneurs. Whether you're an industry expert or an emerging enthusiast, this platform offers unmatched opportunities to learn, connect, and grow.

✨ What to Expect:

Live product showcases
Latest industry trends
Networking with top manufacturers & suppliers
Business expansion opportunities
Insights into the future of healthcare




Discover state-of-the-art solutions that are transforming modern healthcare—from advanced surgical systems to next-gen diagnostic technologies.

Don’t miss your chance to be part of Gujarat’s most powerful healthcare gathering. Secure your entry and experience innovation like never before.




📅 Save the Date: 25–27 September 2026

📍 Venue: Vigyan Bhawan, Science City, Ahmedabad

Be there to witness the next wave of medical innovation at Gujarat Medical Expo 2026 – 2nd Edition.

Connect. Explore. Transform. 🚀
